text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report provides the results of a 30 km/h speed limit warrant analysis conducted on Queensbury Avenue. A 30 km/h speed limit on Queensbury Avenue is not technically justified on this roadway. Currently, the speed limit is posted at 40 km/h.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Queensbury Avenue, between Kingston Road and Clonmore Drive.
